Time Picker

The Time Picker turns a text input into a stepper-based time selector. Use the up/down arrows to adjust hours and minutes, then confirm with OK or grab the current time with Now.

Basic Time Picker

Focus or click the field to open the popup. Hours step one by one while minutes jump by five, matching quick-entry behavior.

HTML
<input type="text" class="zak-input" data-zak-timepicker>

In a Labeled Field

Pair the input with a <label> and use the time picker inside a form. The value is written in 24-hour HH:MM form.

HTML
<label for="meetingTime">Meeting time</label>
<input type="text" id="meetingTime" class="zak-input" data-zak-timepicker>

<script>
    document.getElementById('readTimeBtn').addEventListener('click', function () {
        alert(document.getElementById('meetingTime').value || 'Not set yet');
    });
</script>

Change Event

Every value write fires zak:change on the input with hours, minutes and the formatted value.

No time set yet.

HTML
<input type="text" class="zak-input" id="reminder" data-zak-timepicker>

<script>
    document.getElementById('reminder').addEventListener('zak:change', function (e) {
        console.log(e.detail.hours, e.detail.minutes, e.detail.value);
    });
</script>

CSS Classes

HTML
.zak-timepicker                /* Wrapper injected around the input */
.zak-timepicker-popup          /* Popup (hidden until active) */
.zak-timepicker-header         /* Spinner columns + colon */
.zak-timepicker-column         /* One vertical spinner group */
.zak-timepicker-spin-up        /* Up arrow button */
.zak-timepicker-spin-down      /* Down arrow button */
.zak-timepicker-hour           /* Hour readout */
.zak-timepicker-minute         /* Minute readout */
.zak-timepicker-separator      /* Colon between the columns */
.zak-timepicker-footer         /* Now + OK action row */

/* Toggle class */
.zak-timepicker-popup-active   /* Shows the popup */

JavaScript API

HTML
zak.timePicker.init()      // Bind all [data-zak-timepicker] inputs

// Data attributes:
data-zak-timepicker       // Enables the picker on an input
data-zak-timepicker-format // Reserved format hint ('24h' default)

// Event on the input:
zak:change  // { hours, minutes, value: "HH:MM" }

// Footer actions built into the popup:
Now         // Fills current time from the clock
OK          // Writes the value and closes the popup

Accessibility

  • All spinner arrows and footer buttons are native <button> elements; the readout is a <span> kept in sync.
  • Focusing the field opens the popup and clicking outside or pressing Esc dismisses it.
  • Keep the input inside a <label> or with an aria-label so the purpose is announced.
  • The HH:MM output is unambiguous across locales — format it for display rather than for the stored value.
